entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit supplied original Byzantine VETERAN JAVELINEER into neutral full-body straight-on FRONT T-pose for 3D modeling. Preserve identity, plain pointed riveted helmet, engraved brown LEATHER torso armor and shoulderpads and skirt tabs, purple gold diamond long tunic, LEATHER GLOVES, brown diagonal strap and back javelin carrier containing three spears, belt pouch, gray trousers and tall boots. No elite metal torso armor. Only change pose and placement of held equipment: both arms straight horizontal out sideways at shoulder height, open hands palm down, wrists straight, feet slightly apart. The held long spear AND purple oval shield both detached, placed separately beside character with visible gaps and no contact/overlap with his hands or body. Keep original spear and shield design, purple shield pale vertical band and steel boss. Wide canvas to include fingertips, spear tip and boots. One character one front view only, plain neutral gray studio, realistic original materials/colors, no text, no collage.

Make ONE strict right-facing SIDE PROFILE of same Byzantine VETERAN JAVELINEER in anatomical T pose. Preserve engraved brown LEATHER torso/skirt armor, LEATHER GLOVES, plain pointed riveted helmet, purple gold diamond long tunic, brown diagonal strap, back tube holding three spare javelins, belt pouch, gray pants, tall brown boots. Anatomical T seen exactly side-on: arms spread laterally along shoulder axis perpendicular to image plane, near hand/forearm foreshortened TOWARD CAMERA centered over shoulder; far arm points directly away and is FULLY HIDDEN by torso/near arm. No hand or sleeve pointing forward screen-right, no zombie reach. Face and feet point right, feet slightly apart. Spear and purple oval shield detached and displayed separately to side in empty backdrop without touching or overlapping figure, same detailed weapon/shield designs as Image2. One full person one profile only, plain gray studio, realistic original colors/materials, no text, no collage.
